title: Potato Soup
description: Slow-cooker potato soup finished with a butter-and-cream roux and sour cream, topped with bacon, cheddar and chives.

steps.heading: Slow Cook
steps.text: Combine the potatoes, onion, broth, salt and pepper in a slow cooker. Cook on low for 6 hours.

steps.heading: Cook the Bacon
steps.text: Cook the bacon until crispy, cool on paper towels and dice.

steps.heading: Make the Cream Base
steps.text: Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the flour and mix well, then add the cream and sour cream and stir until thoroughly combined and thickened.

steps.heading: Finish
steps.text: Stir the cream mixture into the slow cooker and cook on low for another 30 minutes.

steps.heading: Serve
steps.text: Top each bowl with shredded cheddar, bacon and chives.
